name: fantactv
description: FantaCTV - Fantasy league application for The Traitors TV show

required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY
required.description: Firebase API Key - Get from Firebase Console > Project Settings

required.name: FIREBASE_ADMIN_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
required.description: Firebase Admin Service Account JSON (stringified) - Keep secret!

required.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
required.description: NextAuth.js secret for JWT signing - Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

required.name: NEXTAUTH_URL
required.description: The canonical URL of your deployment (e.g., https://fantactv.example.com)

domains.note: Configure your domain in Coolify UI. The app will be available on port 3000.

setup: 1. Create a Firebase project at https://console.firebase.google.com
4. Generate a service account key from Project Settings > Service Accounts
5. Stringify the service account JSON for FIREBASE_ADMIN_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
7. Set NEXTAUTH_URL to your deployment domain
postDeployment: After deployment, verify the health endpoint at /api/health
Create an admin user through the Firebase Console
Access the admin panel at /admin to configure leagues
